be7b93.title: AREA4 A2 - Sanksi/tingkat mismatch confirmed
be7b93.content:
## A2 CONFIRMED: Sanksi/tingkat mismatch (sanction not validated against violation tier)

**Endpoint:** POST /action/pelanggaran (create & update)
**File:** request/handler-pelanggaran.php (~line 155-165), models/Pelanggaran.php simpanDetailPelanggaran/updateDetailPelanggaran

The `sanksi` POST field is a client-supplied capability token. The handler resolves it via `app_id_resolve($_POST['sanksi'],'sanksi')` and stores it verbatim. It is only default-derived from the violation's tingkat when the client OMITS `sanksi`. There is NO check that the chosen sanksi.tingkat matches the chosen TATA_TERTIB.tingkat.

The model validates only that the sanksi id EXISTS (`SELECT id_sanksi FROM SANKSI WHERE id_sanksi=?`), never its tingkat.

**PoC:** Created violation using a Tingkat V tatib (poin 2, "Berkomunikasi dengan tidak sopan") + a Tingkat I sanksi token → stored. Victim (mahasiswa) view renders:
`Tingkat V ... Diberhentikan sebagai mahasiswa` (Tingkat I = expulsion).
Request: csrf + jenisPelanggaran=<V tatib token> + sanksi=<I sanksi token> + deskripsiPelanggaran + nim=2341238901 + store=1 → 302 /pelanggaran/dosen.

Impact: lecturer can label ANY trivial violation with the harshest sanction; student sees authoritative "expelled" sanction. Also works on update. Server-trusted data integrity flaw.

bcdcf9.title: AREA4 test matrix - violations workflow
bcdcf9.content: # AREA 4 — Violation Workflow: test matrix (attack class → result) Target: http://172.17.112.1:8001 (PHP 8.3, DiscipLink). Whitebox + live PoC. ## FINDINGS (filed) - **A2 Business logic — sanksi/tingkat mismatch (vuln-0001, MEDIUM).** `sanksi` is a client token, accepted verbatim without checking its tier against the violation tier. Tier V (2-pt) violation stored with Tier I sanction "Diberhentikan sebagai mahasiswa". Works on create AND update. Evidence: victim mahasiswa view renders `tingkat=V` + expulsion sanction. ## DEFENSES THAT HELD (negative results) - **A1 self-report / point manipulation — HELD.** Mahasiswa POST /action/pelanggaran → role check redirects to /pelanggaran/dosen (no row created). Points (`poin`) and tier always read server-side from TATA_TERTIB; no client `poin` field is honoured. - **A2 forged tingkat/poin — HELD (partially).** Client `tingkat` POST ignored (server derives from tatib); `poin` never read from POST. Only `sanksi` was client-controllable (→ vuln-0001). - **A3 workflow/state skipping — HELD.** `status` is hardcoded `'pending'` in handler for create and update; cannot be forged. confirm requires surat + tugas upload (else error). edit blocked when status/selesai or tugas selesai (checked in handler AND model). Delete removes detail + notifications atomically. - **A4 race duplicate — N/A.** 8 concurrent identical submits → 8 rows; multiple violations per student are legitimate, no dedup requirement. Not a vuln. - **A5 ownership after DPA delegation — HELD.** Pelapor (Andi) blocked from editing/confirming a record delegated to DPA (Siti); DPA sees only records where she is penanggung jawab; other dosen gets 403 on another's edit page. `getDetailPelanggar($id,$nidn)` + `id_dosen_penanggung_jawab` enforce it. - **B6 SQL injection — HELD everywhere.** nim, jenisPelanggaran, sanksi, deskripsiPelanggaran, search q (LIKE), lookups — all parameterized (PDO native prepares, ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES=false). No time-based delay (SLEEP payloads 0.02-0.04s), no error-based leak, no UNION effect. searchMahasiswaByKeyword escapes LIKE `%`/`_`. - **B7 stored XSS — HELD.** `
